sloka: पद्म केसर संसृष्टो वृक्षान्तर विनिःसृतः ।निःश्वास इव सीताया वाति वायुः मनोहरः ॥४-१-७२॥
transliteration: padma kesara saṁsṛṣṭo vṛkṣāntara viniḥsṛtaḥ ।niḥśvāsa iva sītāyā vāti vāyuḥ manoharaḥ ॥4-1-72॥

translations.english: 'Look at the very spectacular karnikara tree with its blossmed branches on the mountain slope towards the southern side of Pampa, O Saumitri
